dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, do you read comic books?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, duː juː ˈriːd ˈkɑːmɪk ˌbʊks?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! Japanese comic books. And you?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! ˌdʒæpəˈniːz ˈkɑːmɪk ˌbʊks. ənd ˈjuː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I read magazines. And I listen to music.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈriːd ˌmæɡəˈziːnz. ənd aɪ ˈlɪsən tə ˈmjuːzɪk.
